narr: Afternoon storms over the Sangre de Cristo Mountains slowly moved south across the Hermits Peak Calf Canyon Burn Scar resulting in some flash flooding at Lower Rociada.
ev: Road leading up to residence was covered in flowing water near State Roads 105 and 276 in lower Rociada.
lsr: Near SR 105 and SR 276 in Lower Rociada. Road leading up to residence covered in flowing water.
